# How much does it cost to hire a company to build an AI agent?

As of October 2026, **a custom AI agent can cost anywhere from \$3,000 to \$500,000+**, depending on what you want it to do, which systems it needs to access, and how reliable and autonomous it must be. For many small and midsize business applications, a reasonable starting budget is **\$10,000–\$50,000 for a focused, custom-built agent**\. More complex production systems can cost considerably more. [www.nerdheadz.com](https://www.nerdheadz.com/blog/ai-agent-development-cost?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.kdci.co](https://www.kdci.co/outsourcing-blog/post/ai-agent-development-services?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.scalacode.com](https://www.scalacode.com/blog/ai-agent-development-cost/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## 1\. Typical AI agent development costs

## Simple agent

# \$3,000–\$15,000

Typically 1–4 weeks, depending on scope

Examples: lead qualification, FAQ responses, document summarization, or drafting emails for approval.

---

## Business workflow agent

# \$15,000–\$60,000

Typically 4–12+ weeks

Examples: an agent that researches prospects, updates a CRM, processes invoices, or coordinates multiple business applications.

---

## Advanced or multi-agent system

# \$60,000–\$200,000+

Typically 3–6+ months

Examples: multiple coordinated agents, complex decision-making, extensive integrations, private deployments, and advanced security controls.

---

## Enterprise AI platform

# \$200,000–\$500,000+

Examples: organization-wide automation, regulated data, stringent audit requirements, and integrations across many enterprise systems.

These are indicative budgeting ranges synthesized from published vendor estimates, not fixed industry rates. A tightly scoped project may cost less; enterprise requirements can push costs much higher. [www.nerdheadz.com](https://www.nerdheadz.com/blog/ai-agent-development-cost?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.kdci.co](https://www.kdci.co/outsourcing-blog/post/ai-agent-development-services?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.suffescom.com](https://www.suffescom.com/services/ai-agent-development?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.scalacode.com](https://www.scalacode.com/blog/ai-agent-development-cost/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Important\:** Building the agent is only part of the cost. You may also pay for AI model usage, cloud hosting, third-party software, monitoring, maintenance, and ongoing improvements. Ask vendors to quote these separately.
